nose.reason: Unmaintained; nose's own documentation recommends switching to pytest or the standard library's unittest.

pycrypto.reason: Unmaintained with known unpatched security vulnerabilities; superseded by pycryptodome, a drop-in replacement.

pep8.reason: Renamed by its own maintainers to avoid confusion with the PEP 8 style guide itself.

pypiwin32.reason: Deprecated wrapper package; its functionality was merged directly into pywin32.

flask-babelex.reason: Unmaintained fork of flask-babel; flask-babel absorbed the features flask-babelex added.

nose-parameterized.reason: Renamed by its own maintainers to 'parameterized'; the old package name is an unmaintained alias.

sklearn.reason: Deprecated PyPI placeholder; the real package is published as scikit-learn, and installing 'sklearn' itself prints a deprecation warning.

distribute.reason: Deprecated fork of setuptools; merged back into and superseded by setuptools.

unittest2.reason: Backport of unittest features that have long since landed in the standard library's unittest module.

flask-script.reason: Deprecated by its own maintainers in favor of Flask's built-in CLI (Click-based) since Flask 0.11.

django-rest-swagger.reason: Deprecated by its own maintainers; no longer compatible with actively maintained Django REST Framework versions.

path.py.reason: Renamed by its own maintainers to 'path'; the old package name is an unmaintained alias.
